checks.name: Real build loads offline with honest zero progress and temporary-storage notice
Quran reader, search, bookmarks and recitation consent gate work
Adaptive session starts at the selected length and resumes without replacement
Five-question session updates real evidence, schedules misses and completes
Progress shows actual session results, one missed-card drill and no Tajweed score
Tajweed lesson highlight and rule quiz remain separate from recitation evidence
Recitation screen explicitly distinguishes comparison from pronunciation assessment
Generated audio records to a real MediaRecorder Blob, saves temporarily, and deletes only after confirmation
French translation, Arabic RTL and reduced-motion settings apply immediately
Four main screens have no horizontal overflow across 320, 390, 412, 430 and 1024 pixel viewports
No uncaught JavaScript errors or external requests during consent-disabled test flow

method: Actual single-file build, Chromium set_content, temporary-storage mode. Microphone replaced by a generated Web Audio stream; not a real microphone test.
